sanskrit_verse:
दाप्यस् तु दशमं भागं वाणिज्यपशुसस्यतः ।
अनिश्चित्य भृतिं यस् तु कारयेत स महीक्षिता ॥१९४
transliteration: dāpyas tu daśamaṃ bhāgaṃ vāṇijyapaśusasyataḥ | aniścitya bhṛtiṃ yas tu kārayet sa mahīkṣitā || 194
sph_interpretive_translation: One who employs labor without prior agreement regarding compensation shall be liable to pay a tenth portion of the commercial livestock or produce involved.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from clarity in contractual causation
Causation is determined by intentional capacity to define terms
Capacity-based responsibility requires pre-agreed exchange structures
Restoration logic demands proportional return of value where intent was absent
Consciousness alignment occurs through rectification of unspoken obligations
executable_legal_axioms: IF labor is performed AND no prior wage agreement exists THEN employer owes 10% of relevant commercial asset base
IF service provider lacks explicit consent framework THEN automatic liability equals one-tenth of transactional yield
IF employment initiated without defined remuneration THEN default restitution rate = 0.1 × (vāṇijya/sasya/paśu)
NO punitive damages allowed; ONLY quantifiable restorative transfer permitted
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving informal labor arrangements, the Supreme Court must apply this rule when no written contract exists. The threshold of responsibility lies in the absence of clarity, not malicious intent. Authority resides in restoring economic balance rather than assigning fault.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that uncertainty in payment constitutes incomplete transactional cognition. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how lack of clarity leads to imbalance. Proportional responsibility aligns with measurable output loss. Non-punitive reality rule affirms correction without condemnation.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Employer must calculate and deliver 10% of relevant commercial assets to laborer within 7 days
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Employer publicly acknowledges causal gap and commits to transparency in future engagements
Capacity Restoration: Laborer receives advisory support for formalizing future work agreements
Integrity Reintegration: Both parties participate in community-based mediation affirming mutual recognition of value
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: Dharma is restored through precise execution of value-return where clarity was lacking. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
